name: eslstudeo
description: Build courses, placement tests and classes in ESLStudeo by talking to Claude. Plan and write units, pages and exercises; turn a paper placement test into an online one and send each candidate their own link; find and change wording across a course; check a course's quality; set a class's dates, access, attempts and exam resits; add or move learners; see how a class is getting on; mark written work; answer posts and messages; bring in pictures, recordings and videos from Google Drive; and write to the people who need it, with a notice or email drafts. Includes the ESLStudeo connector, which you approve on eslstudeo.com.
